findings.detail: X01 flags rate-bearing preferred equity although the source schedule explicitly presents these preferred equity instruments with stated rates.

rationale: Class 2 within-row review. The five flagged PRIVATE_EQUITY rows are preferred equity or senior preferred interests, and the raw schedule explicitly places 11.50% or 10.50% in the Interest Rate column for those instruments. The extracted interest_rate values therefore match source; the warning is caused by X01 treating all PRIVATE_EQUITY interest_rate values as suspect instead of allowing rate-bearing preferred equity.
